Based on FY26Q1 data across 8 segments, the exposure-weighted portfolio loss ratio is 0.[PINCODE]. The pricing model recommends a rate of 0.030567 (ratio) with a target combined ratio of 0.96. This reflects current loss experience and reinsurance cede percentages across motor, health, property, marine cargo, and liability lines.

The portfolio loss ratio was computed as an exposure-weighted mean of segment-level loss ratios using FY26Q1 data. Segment exposure units served as weights. The pricing model then applied a target combined ratio of 0.96 to derive the recommended rate from the portfolio loss ratio. Burn cost metrics were computed as severity divided by exposure units for each segment.

Key risks include potential adverse loss development in liability_professional (loss ratio 0.827) and motor_commercial_west (0.803), which have higher-than-average loss ratios. Property_sme_east shows high severity ([PINCODE] INR) with low frequency, creating tail risk. Marine cargo has significant reinsurance cede (35%) but also elevated burn cost. Reinsurance recoverability and changing regulatory environments should be monitored.
